name: OMathRad
description: Represents the mathematical radical object, consisting of a radical, a base, and an optional degree.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathRad object.

properties.name: Deg
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the degree for a radical. Read-only.

properties.name: E
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the base of the specified equation object. Read-only.

properties.name: HideDeg
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to hide the degree for a radical. Read/write.
